subject: Mutual action: launch logistics & evaluation readiness — proposed calendar hold

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action: launch logistics & evaluation readiness — proposed calendar hold

Hi Jordan / Samira —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. To keep momentum toward the Q2 launch and the evaluation window we discussed, attached is a proposed kickoff hold and a lightweight MAP + evaluation checklist for review.

High-level ask: can we lock a 60-minute kickoff next week to align stakeholders, confirm success criteria for the evaluation, and assign owners to the action items below? I’ve proposed Tuesday 4/6 or Wednesday 4/7 in the calendar hold.

Draft agenda (attached as MAP_agenda_v0.3.pdf):
- Introductions & goals (10m)
- Evaluation scope & success metrics (20m)
- Roles & runbook (15m)
- Next steps & timeline to close (15m)

Attachments: evaluation_plan_q2.xlsx (proposed test cases and data slices), stakeholder_roster.csv (who we expect on each side), MAP_agenda_v0.3.pdf

Quick asks:
1) Please confirm preferred kickoff slot (4/6 or 4/7) and who will represent Product and Security on your side.
2) Any constraints for a recording or if you need us to mask customer data during the eval.

I’ll follow up with a Zoom link + final agenda once we have a time.

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

+1 415-555-0122

Thanks Naomi — we’re excited to get this moving. 4/6 is better for our core team, but I can also make 4/7 if it helps the Redwood side.

Attendees from NovaCorp (likely):
- Jordan Miles (Buyer, Cloud Platforms)
- Priya Rao (Product manager) — will confirm
- Arun Patel (Security lead) — requested to be on the invite

Two quick items:
1) Can you add a short block in the agenda for infra/throughput expectations? Our infra team will want to validate the load profile and quantization plan during the eval.
2) We’ll need the meeting recorded and the recording shared with our procurement team. Any concerns on your side about recording?

Also looping Samira from HealthOps who will support the evaluation design on our side.

—Jordan

Jordan — perfect, 4/6 works for us and I’ve proposed 10:00–11:00 PT on the hold. We added an infra/throughput checkpoint into the agenda at the start of the evaluation scope section (10m).

Zoom: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/9876543210 (passcode: Nova2027)
Draft agenda attached; owners we’ve suggested in the agenda are:
- Success metrics & ops owner: Ben Carter (Redwood)
- Evaluation test cases: Marissa Cole (Redwood) & Samira Khan (NovaCorp)
- Security & data handling: Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood) / Arun Patel (NovaCorp)

Recording: we can record and share the recording internally; we’ll redact any sensitive customer examples if needed. Please confirm if that is acceptable.

Action items before kickoff:
- Jordan / Priya: confirm product use cases to prioritize (reply by EOD 4/4)
- Arun / Samira: confirm security checklist gaps (reply by EOD 4/4)
- Redwood: finalize evaluation test harness and share test data template (attached: evaluation_plan_q2.xlsx) by 4/5

Please reply-all with ACKs or changes. I’ll send an updated calendar invite once we have confirmations.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Naomi
